source_note: Four user-uploaded 360p reference copies. The user previously confirmed redistribution/analysis authorization.

method.frame_scan: Every decoded source frame scanned at 30 fps with PySceneDetect ContentDetector threshold 18 and minimum scene length 6 frames; representative boundaries manually spot-checked.
method.transcript: Offline Vosk small English model with word-level timestamps; proper nouns may contain recognition errors.
method.motion: Per-shot sampled-frame optical registration and residual-motion analysis; values marked estimated where source compression or baked composite art prevents exact layer recovery.
method.limitations: The supplied copies are 640x360/30 fps transcodes. Stroke widths and one-frame timings are measured at this resolution and scaled when implementation values are given. Original AE/project files were not available.
